scenes.text: The most important hydrogen in your life might already be on your dinner table.
Hydrogen plus nitrogen from the air makes ammonia, and in the U.S., 88 percent of ammonia goes into fertilizer.
Worldwide, ammonia takes about 60 percent of the hydrogen used in industry.
And about 95 percent of U.S. hydrogen is made from natural gas, the Energy Department says. The full story is on Other End of the Wire.
